name: OpenStreetMap
access: Downloaded .osm.pbf, converted to GeoPackage and loaded into PostGIS by etl/load_osm.py
updateFrequency: Geofabrik publishes daily; refreshed here by re-running the ETL
knownLimitations: Volunteer-mapped, so completeness varies a lot between places. Central Berovo, for example, has 171 mapped buildings where satellite-derived datasets find about 3,400. A missing feature does not mean it does not exist. Some values are overridden by local corrections in etl/corrections, which say so where they apply.

name: Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints
access: Downloaded GeoJSONL tiles, imported with ogr2ogr and clipped to the border by etl/load_microsoft_buildings.py
coverage: North Macedonia (15 tiles, listed by Microsoft as FYROMakedonija)
updateFrequency: Irregular; the MK tiles were last updated 2026-02-23
knownLimitations: Detected from satellite imagery by machine learning: outlines only, with no height, use or address. Quality varies and is weaker in dense urban areas; some outlines are false detections or several buildings merged into one. Some catalogues list this data as ODbL from an earlier release; Microsoft's repository states CDLA Permissive 2.0.

name: Overture Maps places
provider: Overture Maps Foundation, from Meta, Microsoft, Foursquare, AllThePlaces and others
access: GeoParquet downloaded with the overturemaps CLI and clipped to the border by etl/load_overture_places.py
license: Per upstream dataset: CDLA Permissive 2.0 (Meta, Microsoft and others), Apache 2.0 (Foursquare), CC0 1.0 (AllThePlaces)
attribution: Overture Maps Foundation; data from Meta, Microsoft, Foursquare (© 2024 Foursquare Labs, Inc.), AllThePlaces
updateFrequency: Monthly Overture releases; the loaded release is shown under 'Data from'
knownLimitations: Mostly from Meta business pages: listings can be outdated, duplicated or approximately placed, and closed businesses are rarely marked. Each place has a confidence score from 0 to 1; below about 0.5 expect noise.
